description.zh:
过滤机器付费类型，取值如下：
- PrePaid：预付费。
- PostPaid：后付费。
description.en:
Filters instances by billing method. Valid values:

- PrePaid: subscription.

- PostPaid: pay-as-you-go.
The ID of the region where the resource group is located.

description.zh: 关键字搜索。支持按机器ID或IP进行搜索。
description.en: A keyword for the search. You can search by instance ID or IP address.
The IP address of the instance.

description.zh: 按实例ID过滤。如何获取实例ID，请参见[ListResourceInstances](~~412129~~)。
description.en: Filter by instance ID. For more information, see [ListResourceInstances](~~412129~~).

description.zh: 专属资源组机器列表的页码。起始值为1，默认为1。
description.en: The page number. The value starts from 1. The default value is 1.

description.zh: 分页查询时设置的每页显示的机器数量，默认为100。
description.en: The number of instances to return on each page. Default value: 100.

description.zh: 资源组的ID。如何查询资源组ID，请参见[ListResources](~~412133~~)。
description.en: The ID of the resource group. For more information, see [ListResources](~~412133~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eas list-resource-instances --cluster-id cn-shanghai --resource-id iot --charge-type PrePaid --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --instance-name e-xxxx000 --instance-id i-bp1jd6x3uots0000a --instance-ip 10.224.xx.xx --filter 10.224.xx.xx --instance-status Ready --label key=example-string --sort CreateTime --order desc --zone J --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eas GET /api/v2/resources/cn-shanghai/iot/instances --region cn-hangzhou --Order desc --InstanceName 'e-xxxx000' --PageSize 20 --InstanceId 'i-bp1jd6x3uots0000a' --PageNumber 1 --Filter '10.224.xx.xx' --Zone J --ChargeType PrePaid --InstanceStatus Ready --Label '{"key":"example-string"}' --InstanceIP '10.224.xx.xx' --Sort CreateTime --header "Content-Type=application/json"
